newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian Q2 GDP rose provisional 0.5 pct. [Corrected 11:13 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Italian Q2 GDP rose provisional 0.5 pct. [Corrected 11:13 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects period in headline from Q1 to Q2).
Italy's gross domestic product (GDP) rose by a provisional 0.5 percent, year on year, in the second quarter of 1996, National Statistics Institute Istat said.
Note: Istat said the quarter-on-quarter (Corrects from month-on-month) fall in GDP in the second quarter was due mostly to a fall in industrial output.
-- The service sector by comparison registered a slight increase.
-- Istat said there were two fewer working days in the second quarter than in the first quarter.
-- Final GDP data for the second quarter will be released on October 4.
